title: why iron is important for women
description: why iron is important for women

segments.text: Did you know that you can lose up to 20 mg of iron every single period? Around one in three women are iron deficient. But why? Here are a couple of reasons. First, women lose an average [music] of 30 to 40 ml of blood every single period. And every ml of blood has around 1/2 a mg of iron in it, meaning you can lose around 12 to 20 mg per cycle.

Second, on top of that, women can have things like uterine fibroids or like myself, endometriosis, which can cause heavy and longer [music] periods than usual, which deplete your iron over time. Third, iron is surprisingly [music] hard to absorb. Your body actually only absorbs a fraction of the iron you eat, and that absorption depends on what you eat it with.
